newsitem.title: LATVIA: LATVIA-TWO MPS LEAVE SAIMNIEKS PARTY.
newsitem.headline: LATVIA-TWO MPS LEAVE SAIMNIEKS PARTY.

text.p: Two MPs have left the largest party in parliament, the Democratic Party Saimnieks, citing differences with the party in several areas.
MPs Janis Strods and Andrius Saulitis will now become independent deputies, they told journalists.
The defections leave Saimnieks as still the largest party in the 100-seat parliament by far with 24 seats versus 16 seats for next-largest party Latvia's Way.
